abilities.name: Blazing Stampede

evidence.quote: Active - Stance: Udyr enters Stampede Stance, empowering his basic attacks to have an uncancellable windup and pounce on the target to stun them for 0.75 seconds.
He also gains immunity to crowd control for 1.5 seconds.

notes: Udyr cannot dash while grounded or rooted, but he will still declare the empowered attack.
The empowered attack will still apply its effects even if the dash is interrupted.
The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

Each empowered attack is considered to belong to its own cast instance.
  - The immunity to the stun is not applied in any case.

abilities.name: Bridge Between
notes:
Axiom Arcanist will affect the Awakened cast of all abilities, but does not refund the cooldown of Awakened Spirit.
  - Only Wilding Claw lightning damage is amplified. The on-hit damage is not increased.
The empowered attacks will not get consumed if they are parried.

abilities.name: Wilding Claw
notes: Spell shield will only block an empowered attack's application of the lightning strikes.
The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

abilities.name: Wingborne Storm

evidence.quote: Additionally, Udyr summons a blizzard around himself for 4 seconds that deals magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies and slows them while they remain within.

notes: The storm will remain active even if Udyr dies. Any commands it was issued to follow a target will not be interrupted.
The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.
